dct_description_sm: The purpose of this multi-year project was to conduct a systematic and thorough evaluation of the risks and vulnerabilities climate change poses to Black River First Nation (FN). As a community dependent on the boreal forest, changes in forest composition and the increased risk of fire are detrimental to the community's health. The end goals were the revision of the existing Black River FN community plan and the creation of a Community Wildfire Protection Plan. This incorporated climate change adaptation strategies into both the community planning and a planned cottage subdivision (to be built on adjacent crown land), run by the Black River FN.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Resilience

dct_title_s: Vulnerability/Risk Assessment and Development of Adaptation Strategies in the Face of Climate Change in Black River First Nation, Manitoba: A Community Approach
